notifications.title: S-RCS v1.3.3 Released!
notifications.message:
Major update with real enterprise deployment hardening:

- LDAP Connection Test button in installer (verify AD credentials before completing setup)
- Step-by-step update instructions with copy-to-clipboard commands
- Full i18n for update modal (5 languages: EN/AZ/DE/RU/TR)
- Docker security hardening: proper SSL cert with SAN, ServerName fix, HTTPS redirect port correction
- System identifier Docker compatibility (hostname hash fallback)
- config.php removed from git tracking (security + clean clone)
- Pre-made PowerShell test data generator (up to 10,000 AD objects)
- GitHub notifications system fixed

notifications.title: S-RCS v1.3.2 - LDAP Pagination & Auto-Update Check
notifications.message:
Critical fixes for large-scale AD environments:

- LDAP pagination for Groups, GPOs, OUs, Computers (supports 1000+ objects)
- GPO listing optimization: 101 queries -> 2 queries (50x faster)
- Auto Update Check with GitHub integration and footer badge
- Report generation restored for large domains
- Docker network tools added (ip, arp, ping)
- SSL certificate hardening (CA:FALSE + SAN)

notifications.title: S-RCS v1.3.0 Released!
notifications.message: New version includes Task Management System, Audit Logging, and improved Security Lock mechanism. Update your installation to get the latest features!

notifications.title: Security Lock Mechanism
notifications.message: The installation wizard now uses a file-based security lock. After installation, delete config/.installed to reinstall.
